brainlife.desc: T2-weighted anatomical MRI volume (NIfTI), used with T1w for HCP-style preprocessing, myelin mapping and registration.
brainlife.name: neuro/anat/t2w
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Second structural contrast for HCP structural preprocessing, T1w/T2w myelin maps and hippocampal subfields. Anatomical reference for registering diffusion maps.

**Not for:** Use as a T1w substitute in Apps that need T1 contrast. Public sharing before defacing.

**BIDS:** anat/T2w (equivalent)

**Sharing:** Tier 3 (directly identifiable or traceable) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 43 Apps, output of 14 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.anat.t2w.json

identifying_risks: Face is recognisable in non-defaced images
JSON metadata may hold acquisition dates, institution or device serials
sharing_cautions: Deface before sharing outside a controlled project
